architecture.ui: WPF + Fluent Design (Acrylic translucent backdrop, Opacity slider, Light/Dark/System follow, WS_EX_NOACTIVATE)

native_interop.monitor_positioning: GetCursorPos -> MonitorFromPoint -> GetMonitorInfo (BottomRight, TopRight, TopLeft, BottomLeft, NearCursor)

subsystems.ClipboardMonitor: Services/ClipboardMonitor.cs (HwndSource message hook, 5x lock retry, suppression scope for internal writes)
subsystems.DataTypeDetector: Services/DataTypeDetector.cs (Configurable filters: HexColor, UnixTimestamp, Json, Url, Base64, TableData, Code, Image, PlainText)
subsystems.ActionExecutor: Services/ActionExecutor.cs (CopyText, CopyImage, CopyBase64Image, OpenBrowser, GenerateAndCopyQrCode, SaveImageToFile)
subsystems.FlyoutWindowManager: Services/FlyoutWindowManager.cs (Placement: BottomRight, TopRight, TopLeft, BottomLeft, NearCursor; dynamic opacity)
subsystems.ThemeService: Services/ThemeService.cs (System, Light, Dark dynamic theme switching)
subsystems.TrayIconService: Services/TrayIconService.cs (H.NotifyIcon.Wpf with native Icon, Settings menu, theme & language submenu)
subsystems.LocalizationService: Services/LocalizationService.cs (Auto/Ja/En full i18n dictionary for flyout and settings)
subsystems.SettingsWindow: Views/SettingsWindow.xaml (PowerToys card-style configuration window with opacity slider and detector toggles)

distribution.installer: installer/ClipFlyout.iss (Inno Setup 6, self-contained single-file win-x64, multi-language EN/JA)

Json.pattern: Trimmed starts with { or [ and ends with } or ], validated via JsonDocument.Parse

Base64.pattern: data:image/... or valid Base64 encoded string

TableData.pattern: Multi-line TSV (tabs) or CSV (commas) with uniform columns

Code.pattern: Code keywords regex / braces / semicolons / indentation heuristics

PlainText.pattern: Fallback for all other string content

resolved_issues: Added Fluent acrylic translucency with customizable opacity slider (50%~100%)
Added TopLeft placement option for multi-monitor work areas
Added Unix timestamp detection with local/ISO/epoch actions
Added Base64 detection with text decode and image extraction
Added CSV/TSV table detection with Markdown table and JSON array conversions
Eliminated toast overlap by replacing action buttons with inline checkmark feedback banner during confirmation
Replaced gaudy high-saturation badges with refined Windows 11 Fluent design pastel/tint badges
Added full System/Light/Dark theme support with live Windows OS theme tracking
Added PowerToys-style grouped card Settings window with persistence in settings.json
